newsitem.title: USA: Voice Powered may end as ongoing business.
newsitem.headline: Voice Powered may end as ongoing business.

text.p: Voice Powered Technology International Inc on Tuesday said it has yet to file its form 10-QSB with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission because of financial problems that may affect its ability to continue as a going concern.
The filing, for the quarterly period ended March 31, was due by May 15. Details were not immediately available.

Voice Powered, a maker of electronics products using voice recognition technology, in recent months has failed to file its form 10-KSB for 1996 and has been unable to complete a proposed merger with Franklin Electronic Publishers Inc.
